name: C · 青岚灵葫
summary: 偏侧低髻 · 圆袖短摆 · 俏皮灵巧
detail: An ADULT playful clever charm-keeper Taoist, round short face with soft blunt chin, curved asymmetrical brows, one eye slightly squinted with a bright toothy asymmetric smile, short small nose; not baby or doll anatomy. CHESTNUT hair with a side-parted short curved forelock and ONE low OFFSET SIDE COIL BUN at the back, a simple pale-jade crescent clip and two short apricot fabric ends, no double buns, high ponytail or long straight hair. Pale JADE/cream/apricot bronze palette. Carefully fitted short jade cross-collar blouse with rounded cream facing enclosing fuller bust, little rounded puff sleeves, one small round cloud shoulder layer, narrow apricot fabric waistband, two rounded petal short panels over roomy jade-gray knee-length trousers, cream ankle wraps and soft green flat shoes. Graphic rhythm circles and buoyant curved short hems, ONE large quiet cream cloud motif. POSE lively slight hip turn and a small side step with one knee flexed and both feet distinct; one hand raises a SINGLE small bronze ritual bell near shoulder (finger grip correct, bell simple round outline), other hand carries a SMALL round gourd ritual vessel by its short strap beside hip; gourd has ONE yellow talisman seal with cinnabar abstract marks and no leaf/medicine symbol. No big medicine basket, no bow, no sword. Tiny talisman pouch only one. Cheerful adult curves, light tailoring not huge robe or generic sorceress. Bell and sealed gourd match the round personality and palette.
